project_info.theme: Myprotein-style partner power sale for a hero product and free gift
project_info.color_palette: Pale Yellow, Black, White, Orange Mango Accent, Lemon Yellow, Teal

main_subject.detail: A pale-yellow partner-sale poster with Ultimate Sup x REF_PARTNER_LOGO at top, a large {{EVENT_MARK}} {{EVENT_NAME}}, a wide white hero-product card, a black free-gift card below, cropped REF_HERO_PRODUCTS at corners, and a rounded black CTA.
main_subject.style: Clean performance ecommerce poster, product-led composition, simple high-legibility cards

composition_elements.type: Partner lock-up / hero-product card / gift card / packshot frames
items: Upper Middle: Oversized {{EVENT_MARK}} and {{EVENT_NAME}} with supporting line.
Center: Wide white card naming {{HERO_PRODUCT_COPY}}; main REF_HERO_PRODUCT stands on or overlaps the card.
Lower Middle: Black gift card with REF_GIFT_PRODUCT and {{GIFT_LABEL}}.
Corners: Supporting REF_HERO_PRODUCTS cropped as visual frames.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Soft pale-yellow gradient, creamy container highlights, clean contact shadows, energetic black-yellow offer contrast

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity partner-brand product offer poster

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: Create a square Ultimate Sup x REF_PARTNER_LOGO power-sale poster. Preserve the pale-yellow background and stacked card composition: top partner lock-up, large {{EVENT_MARK}} {{EVENT_NAME}}, a white center card with {{HERO_PRODUCT_COPY}} and REF_HERO_PRODUCT, a black lower card with REF_GIFT_PRODUCT plus {{GIFT_LABEL}}, cropped supporting REF_HERO_PRODUCTS in the corners, and rounded black {{CTA}} at bottom. Keep all product packs label-facing and exact commercial terms approved.
prompt.negative_prompt: wrong partner logo, distorted product tub, unsupported product claim, unreadable product headline, missing gift item, low contrast, watermark, cropped CTA

assets.name: Partner product hero and gift layout
assets.usage: Preserve stacked title, white hero card, black gift card, corner packshots, and CTA.

assets.name: Partner brand logo
assets.usage: Use only for active partner campaign.

assets.name: Main promoted product
assets.usage: Place overlapping the white hero card.

assets.name: Supporting product/flavour packshots
assets.usage: Use only as cropped corner frames.

assets.name: Free gift product
assets.usage: Place inside the lower black gift card.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach all brand/product refs. Keep nutritional and product text on the packaging from real packshots; compose final campaign words, gift rules, and price/discount terms after approval.

substitutable_fields.default: 8.8 / POWER SALE / Fuel harder workouts with exclusive deals

substitutable_fields.replacement_rule: Use exact SKU name and active product packshot.
Use only approved selected-order terms and gift SKU.
